rows.grounds: object or coordinate practice named alongside application
compound describing the meditated form; qualifies an implied feminine object

items.question: What additional application and visualization are prescribed alongside the preceding oblation practice?
premises: The meditated form is adorned with fifty letters.
items.inference: The ritual practice extends beyond oblation to include a distinct application and meditation on a form adorned with fifty letters.
uncertainties: The feminine accusative paṃcāśadvarṇaśobhitām implies an unstated object, likely the goddess.
items.plain_english: There is also a separate application and meditation on her who is adorned with the fifty letters.
